```yaml
name: Docusaurus Documentation Site

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'website/**'

jobs:
  build-and-validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Docusaurus site
        working-directory: website
        run: npm run build

      - name: Check CLAUDE.md size
        id: claude_md_size
        run: |
          md_size=$(wc -c < ../CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDE.md size is $md_size bytes"
          if (( md_size > 25000 )); then
            echo "::error::CLAUDE.md exceeds 25k characters"
            exit 1
          fi

  deploy-to-cloudflare:
    needs: build-and-validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm install

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
          folder: website/build
          commit-message: Deploy Docusaurus documentation site
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a CI/CD pipeline for the `smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go` repository to automatically build and validate the Docusaurus documentation site when changes are pushed to the `main` branch or when pull requests are opened affecting the `docs/` or `website/` directories. It also includes a step to check the size of the `CLAUDE.md` file and fail the build if it exceeds 25k characters. The workflow deploys the built site to Cloudflare Pages upon successful validation.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'website/**'

jobs:
  build-and-validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Docusaurus site
        working-directory: website
        run: npm run build

      - name: Check CLAUDE.md size
        id: claude_md_size
        run: |
          md_size=$(wc -c < ../CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDE.md size is $md_size bytes"
          if (( md_size > 25000 )); then
            echo "::error::CLAUDE.md exceeds 25k characters"
            exit 1
          fi

  deploy-to-cloudflare:
    needs: build-and-validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm install

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
          folder: website/build
          commit-message: Deploy Docusaurus documentation site
